app.name: Alaa
app.description: Point your camera at something everyday and see where the Quran mentions it.

welcome.intro: Alaa helps you notice everyday blessings you have grown used to: water, light, the food on your table.
welcome.refrainNote: This verse is repeated {count} times in Surah Ar-Rahman.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.body: Alaa needs a connection to recognize photos. Check your connection and try again.

lens.intro: Point your camera at something around you, or try one of the sample photos.
lens.samplesHint: No camera nearby? Try one of these.
lens.privacy: Your photo is shrunk on your device, analyzed, then discarded. It is never stored.

confirm.title: Is this…?
confirm.hint: I'm not sure. Pick what you photographed.

abstain.person: Alaa doesn't analyze people. Try photographing an object near you.
abstain.unsafe: This photo can't be used. Try something else around you.

errors.title: Something went wrong

errors.daily-limit: You've reached today's limit for new photos. Sample photos still work, and you can try again tomorrow.
errors.model-unavailable: Recognition is unavailable right now. Try again in a minute, or try a sample photo.
errors.invalid-image: This file isn't a photo Alaa can read. Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
errors.too-large: This photo is too large. Choose another photo.
errors.decode: Couldn't open this photo. Try another one, or a sample photo.
errors.invalid-request: Something went wrong. Please try again.

card.underReviewHint: The link between this blessing and this verse has not yet been reviewed by a qualified scholar.
card.meaningNote: The translation conveys the meaning; the Quran is the Arabic text.
card.readInContextLabel: Read {ref} in context on quran.com (opens in a new tab)
card.blockedBody: Its verse text could not be verified against the source, so Alaa shows nothing rather than risk an error.

stage.question: How well do you know the Quran?
stage.hint: Optional. Saved on this device only; change it any time.

today.title: My Day's Surah
today.count: {count, plural, =0 {No blessings yet today} one {{shown} blessing today} other {{shown} blessings today}}
today.empty: Nothing here yet. When a blessing card opens, tap “Add to My Day” and it will appear here, followed by the refrain.
today.cardError: This device couldn't draw the card. Try another browser.
today.privacy: Your day is saved on this device only. Nothing is sent to a server.

journey.title: Ar-Rahman Journey
journey.intro: Seven stations, in the order these blessings come in Surah Ar-Rahman. At each one, find the blessing around you and photograph it, or read its card.
journey.afterLocked: After station 7, your next steps open here.
journey.privacy: Your progress is saved on this device only.

s1.title: Man and speech
s1.mission: Find a pen, or something handwritten.

s2.title: The sun and the moon
s2.mission: Photograph the moon, or sunlight. Never look straight at the sun.

s3.title: Stars and trees
s3.mission: Find a tree or a plant near you.

s4.title: The sky and the balance
s4.mission: Look up and photograph the sky.

s5.title: Earth, fruit and palms
s5.mission: Find dates, a palm tree or some grain.

s6.title: The two seas
s6.mission: Photograph the sea, if you are near one.

s7.title: Pearls and coral
s7.mission: Find a pearl or coral, even in a piece of jewellery.

after.title: After the journey
after.intro: You have walked all seven stations.
after.readLink: Surah Ar-Rahman with translation on quran.com
after.habitLink: Look back at My Day's Surah each evening

about.title: About Alaa
about.lead: A lens for seeing blessings: point your camera at something everyday and see where the Quran mentions it.
about.is: Technology that helps you notice the blessings you have grown so used to that you no longer see them. Its one job is to connect something in front of you to where the Quran mentions it.
about.isNot: Alaa is not a mushaf app, a tafsir, a fatwa service or a place to ask religious questions. It says nothing of its own about religion: every verse is shown exactly as it is in a verified source, with its reference.
about.ai: The AI only sees. It names what is in your photo by choosing from a closed list of {count} everyday concepts, with a confidence. It never chooses verses and never writes religious text. When it is unsure, it asks “Is this…?” or says it doesn't know.
about.aiMapping: Each concept is linked to its verses in a fixed table written by people, not by the AI.
about.sourcesQuran: Quran text: the Tanzil Project, Uthmani script, unmodified. Every ayah is checked against its SHA-256 fingerprint before it is shown; if it doesn't match, nothing is shown.
about.sourcesTranslation: English translation: Talal Itani (ClearQuran.com), CC BY-ND 4.0. A translation conveys the meaning; the Quran is the Arabic text.
about.sourcesVerify: Every verse links to quran.com, so you can read it in its surah and check it yourself.
about.review: The links between blessings and verses show “Mapping under review” until a qualified reviewer approves them. Short reflections stay hidden until they are reviewed. Every review is recorded publicly.
about.privacy: Your photo is shrunk on your device, analyzed, then discarded: it is never stored or logged. My Day, your journey and your learning stage are saved on this device only. There are no accounts and no tracking.
about.questions: Alaa does not answer religious questions. For those, please ask people qualified to answer.
about.report: If a verse, a translation or a link between a blessing and a verse looks wrong, please tell us. Each source page also has its own report link.
about.builtTitle: Built for the AI Challenge for Islamic Content
about.built: Alaa was built during the AI Challenge for Islamic Content (Track 3: Interactive Experiences & Knowledge Journeys), October 4–6, 2026. The code is open.
